quotes: Secrets aren't an entire story. They're not complete pictures.
If they miss the check the secret may come up some other way.

sources.takeaway: Separate useful facts from flexible delivery; revelations fuel choices instead of prescribing them.

sources.method: direct HTTP 200, complete HTML and parsed text; some dash encoding artifacts retained
quotes: These locations can do things. These locations have "moves".
Do the characters or NPCs trigger them by doing something or moving somewhere?
You can end effects a few ways as well.
sources.takeaway: Give features interactions, triggers, consequences and counterplay.

sources.method: direct HTTP 200, complete HTML and parsed text
quotes: Give the NPC a strong agenda. Make them want something.
It actually works best if this agenda is not aimed directly at the PCs.
Have NPCs connected to each other and give them strong, contradictory opinions about each other.
sources.takeaway: Context-dependent agendas and relationships, not isolated traits.

quotes: Don’t prep plots, prep situations.
For any conclusion you want the PCs to make, include at least three clues.
sources.takeaway: Circumstances/resources/intentions rather than predetermined player actions; redundancy for required conclusions.
